Sandbox_FWOFitness_InitialPerkBonus_tool: Take the initial perk bonus into account (75% 100% 125%)
Sandbox_FWOFitness_currentExerciseRegula: Get a bonus for the current exercise depending on the regularity
Sandbox_FWOFitness_currentExerciseOffset: The 0 point for the linear calculation
Sandbox_FWOFitness_currentExerciseRate_t: The steepness of the linear angle (higher number = higher multiplier and higher negatives with offset)
Sandbox_FWOFitness_AverageExerciseRegula: Get a bonus depending on the average of all your exercises regularity
Sandbox_FWOFitness_LevelBonus_tooltip: How much multiplier you get per perk level
Sandbox_FWOFitness_SpaceOutExercise_tool: Get an exp buff when you space out exercises (about 8hr or when muscle soreness sets in) independent for fitness and strength
Sandbox_FWOFitness_SpaceOutExerciseNegat: The multiplier applied when you exercise too soon after previous session
Sandbox_FWOFitness_RestedBonus_tooltip: Get an exp debuff when you have muscle soreness, buff when rested (no muscle soreness)
Sandbox_FWOFitness_RestedBonusNegative_t: The multiplier applied when you have muscle soreness
Sandbox_FWOFitness_XPMultiplier_tooltip: Global exp multiplier (makes you earn experience faster or slower, small increments recommended)
Sandbox_FWOFitness_PassiveMultiplier_too: Determines how much multiplier you get outside of doing exercises. EG. fighting, sprinting,... (0 = OFF, no passive exp multiplier)
Sandbox_FWOFitness_BoredomMultiplier_too: Adjust boredom reduction gained from exercise (0 = off)
Sandbox_FWOFitness_UnhappynessMultiplier: Adjust unhappiness reduction gained from exercise (0 = off)
Sandbox_FWOFitness_KeepBagsOn_tooltip: Keep backpacks and bags equipped during exercise
Sandbox_FWOFitness_DropBags_tooltip: Drop removed bags on the floor when unequipped for exercise
